description: Local CSV validation contract; not an official organizer schema. Extra metadata columns are allowed. Rows preserve submission rank.
antibody_length_policy: Nonempty chains; no numeric limit inferred from the FAQ. Antibody annotation requires separate review.
normalization: None: uppercase sequences and exact case-sensitive unique names; reject surrounding name whitespace.
empty_policy: Reject by default; allow a header-only scaffold with --allow-empty.
